text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Japanese Derby...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Trainer. To the promised land.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Now... I wonder how much I'm gonna get
booed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd goes wild the second Vodka
walks out
of the paddock. It's a mix of
both admiration and
disdain.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, there it is... Exactly what I
expected.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Half are kissin' me and half are dissin'
me. But
hey, they're all looking at me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Triple Crown tour fans.
You'll be
watchin' me today.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Tellin' me not to think too lightly
of the
Derby, huh? But here's the thing...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm not here to take it lightly! So don't
you take
me lightly either.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Of course not! This is my starting grid.
I've wanted
to stand here ever since I
was a kid. And now...
choice_data_list: ああ、後悔はしてないな？
うん、後悔はしてないよね？
choice_data_list_en: Yeah. You don't have any regrets, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm stepping into unknown territory!
Anyone who
can overcome that and win
is super cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm gonna do it, Trainer. I'm
definitely
gonna win.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I don't care how strong my opponents
could be,
I'm still gonna win and become
Derby champion!
